mentions.story: Ask HN: How can I improve the design of my side project, TakeItApart.com?
mentions.text: Check what type of audience Khan Academy's Reverse Engineering section has ( [course]). I believe you have the same audience. But I also believe that videos are much more effective to learn how things work than photos. Maybe you should explore that road. Good luck.
